sections.title: Handling advance fees and instalment plans
sections.body: Training centres rarely collect revenue in a single, simple transaction. You bill for a full term or a lengthy certification course before the first class begins. Many students or parents cannot pay the entire sum upfront, requiring you to manage complex instalment plans. Paper & Pen allows you to generate invoices for the full course value and issue separate payment receipts as each instalment arrives. You can easily check customer ledgers to see exactly which students are falling behind on their payment schedules, allowing you to follow up before the next term starts.
items: Bill full course fees before classes begin
Log partial payments against large tuition invoices
Send payment reminders for overdue instalments
Track outstanding balances per student or parent

sections.title: Managing discounts and proof of payment
sections.body: To fill seats, education businesses rely heavily on early-bird pricing, corporate group rates, and sibling discounts. Applying these deductions manually on a calculator leads to errors and confused parents. With our invoicing tools, you can add specific discount lines directly to the quotation or invoice, showing the exact calculation. When the payment clears, you can immediately generate a per-student receipt. This gives the payer immediate confirmation and keeps your internal records perfectly aligned with the cash you actually collected.
items: Apply percentage discounts for early enrolments
Deduct fixed amounts for sibling registrations
Issue instant payment receipts via WhatsApp link
Convert group training quotations into final invoices

sections.title: Recognising revenue as the course is delivered
sections.body: Collecting a three-month term fee in September does not mean you earned all that money in September. In education accounting, upfront payments are unearned fee income (a liability) until you actually teach the classes. Paper & Pen provides a full general ledger, allowing you or your accountant to post manual journal entries. You can shift that liability into recognised revenue month by month as the course progresses. This ensures your profit and loss statement reflects the true financial health of your training centre, rather than showing massive spikes at the start of every term.
items: Record upfront tuition as unearned fee income
Post journal entries to recognise monthly revenue
Generate accurate profit and loss statements
Keep balance sheets updated with current liabilities

faqs.q: Can I track which students have paid their monthly instalments?
faqs.a: Yes. By creating a customer profile for each student or parent, you can view their individual ledger. When you issue an invoice for the term, you can log multiple partial payments against it as they pay their instalments. The system clearly shows the remaining balance, so you always know who is fully paid and who needs a payment reminder before the next class.

faqs.q: Does the software handle sibling and early-bird discounts?
faqs.a: Absolutely. When you create an invoice or quotation for a course, you can add discount lines directly to the document. You can apply a percentage discount for an early-bird registration or a fixed amount deduction for a sibling. The final document shows the original fee, the exact discount applied, and the final total, keeping the pricing completely transparent for the parent.

faqs.q: How do I account for term fees paid in advance?
faqs.a: Paper & Pen includes full double-entry accounting. When a student pays a large term fee upfront, you can record the invoice payment and then use a manual journal entry to classify that cash as unearned fee income on your balance sheet. As your teachers deliver the course over the following months, you can post journals to move that money into recognised revenue.

faqs.q: Can I send payment receipts directly to parents?
faqs.a: Yes, the moment you log a payment against an invoice, you can generate a formal payment receipt. You can share this receipt directly with the parent or adult learner using a secure link via email or WhatsApp. The software supports multiple languages, including Arabic and Hindi, ensuring the receipt is clear and professional.
